### Final Promise
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-feb-21-2008-11568786.html
Passage: Genesis 47:27-31
Points:
- Making solemn commitments to dying family members is a timeless and deeply meaningful responsibility.
- Placing a hand under the thigh was an ancient oath-taking ritual signifying binding loyalty.
- Jacob insisted on being buried in Canaan because he refused to treat Egypt as the Promised Land.
- Although Jacob's earlier years were marked by deceit, his advanced age showed deep spiritual growth.
- Jacob ended his earthly life by turning his heart in reverent worship to God.

### Fruitfulness in Egypt
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fruitfulness-egypt
Passage: Genesis 47:27-28
Points:
- Israel's rapid growth in Goshen proved God's reliability in keeping His covenant promises to Abraham.
- Jacob trusted the Lord's guidance into Egypt even when the divine purpose was hard to discern.
- The description of Israel's multiplication directly echoes God's original creation mandate given to Adam.
- While the nation of Israel stumbled, Jesus succeeded as the last Adam by perfectly fulfilling humanity's calling.
- Those who belong to Christ are called to reflect His righteousness and declare His glory.
